title: Using large language models to promote health equity

bias_targets.methodology: The paper reviews and proposes the application of LLMs to detect and evaluate human racial bias in healthcare. The methodology involves using LLMs to analyze clinical notes and medical textbooks for subtle linguistic biases, such as differences in sentiment, tone, stereotypes, and racialized doubts regarding patient credibility (e.g., identifying when Black patients are disproportionately labeled as "difficult").
